department.name: City of Nashua Parks and Recreation Department (Division of Public Works)
department.hours: Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
department.what: Maintains city parks, playgrounds, ballfields, stadiums, three outdoor pools and seasonal ice rinks, and runs youth sports, trips, special events, garden plots and facility rentals. Program cancellation line 603-589-3360.

registration.label: Register for programs (RecDesk)
registration.note: Used for Biddy Basketball, swim lessons, public trips, summer camps and Greeley Park gazebo permits. In-person registration at 848 West Hollis Street.

facilities.name: Mine Falls Park
features: 325 acres between the Nashua River and the Mill Pond canal system
Walking trails, part of the NH Heritage Trail system since 1992
Walking, biking, boating, fishing and cross-country skiing
Entrances include Whipple Street, Lincoln Park and the Stellos Stadium side
facilities.hours: Monday to Sunday, 6 a.m. to 10 p.m.
facilities.note: Park rules (from the Park Rules page): pets on leash, carry out trash, no alcohol, camping, fires or motorized vehicles. The Stellos Stadium entrance is shown on the citywide parks map. Trail map PDF at nashuanh.gov/DocumentCenter/View/2328.

projects.title: Greeley Park wading pool replacement
projects.summary: The city issued a design-build bid (IFB0897-050726) on April 16, 2026 to fully replace the wading pool at 100 Concord Street with new water lines and concrete decking, with bids due May 7, 2026. Work could begin June 1, 2026 and must finish by May 21, 2027.
projects.cost: Not stated in the bid; Aldermen approved a $75,000 supplemental item in January 2025 covering pool locker room surfaces and the 1923 wading pool

source.label: Greeley Park Wading Pool Design and Construction bid (PDF)

projects.title: Greeley Park bandshell repairs
projects.summary: Bid IFB0748-050825 (April 2025) covers a new metal roof, new panels, painting, new ceiling panels and weatherproof sound and electrical cabinets for the late-1980s bandshell. The contract allowed work from November 3, 2025 with completion required by April 24, 2026.

projects.title: Greeley Park Stone House improvements
projects.summary: Bid IFB0774-040925 (March 2025) rehabilitates the 1911 Stone House pavilion with ADA-compliant bathrooms, a roof replacement and structural repairs. A January 2025 Board of Aldermen report put the engineering estimate at about $995,000.

source.label: Board of Aldermen supplemental capital spending, Jan 7, 2025 (Citizen Portal)

projects.title: Millyard dog park
projects.summary: A 2021 feasibility study found the Millyard parcel (Lot 77-5) near the Mine Falls Park entrance is a feasible site for a public dog park, with flood plain limits to be managed by design. The Animal and Dog Park Advisory Committee is forming a nonprofit to fund, build and run it.

projects.title: Mine Falls Hydroelectric Project relicensing (FERC No. 3442)
projects.summary: The city filed a final hydroelectric license application, revised July 6, 2022, for the Mine Falls hydro plant in the park. The city page does not say whether FERC has acted.

seasonal.title: City pools closed for the season
seasonal.detail: Crown Hill, Rotary and Centennial pools are closed for the 2026 season. The Greeley Park wading pool is dawn to dusk in season and is slated for replacement.

seasonal.title: Outdoor ice rinks open when weather allows
seasonal.detail: Three outdoor rinks: Roby Park (general skating 10am to 8pm, no hockey), Labine Park (hockey only, 11am to 10pm) and Four Corners on Sargent Ave (general skating 11am to 4:30pm and 6 to 10pm, hockey 8 to 11am and 4:30 to 6pm). No skate rentals; rinks may close in warm weather.

seasonal.title: Walking Club ends October 30
seasonal.detail: The Friday Walking Club at the Nashua River Rail Trail ends for 2026 on October 30 and returns in April 2027.

seasonal.title: Nashua Trick-or-Treat
seasonal.detail: City trick-or-treat hours are Saturday, October 31, 6 to 8 p.m.

seasonal.title: Santa in the Park
seasonal.detail: Meet Santa at Greeley Park, Saturday, December 5, 12 to 2 p.m. Free, with a small gift and candy cane for each child.

seasonal.title: Skate parks close in wet weather
seasonal.detail: David Deane (Stadium Drive, 8am to 10pm) and Ash Street (8am to dusk) skate parks close during rain, snow, ice or wet surface conditions.

methodology: Compiled from City of Nashua Parks and Recreation pages, the city's facility directory, bid documents and the citywide parks map on nashuanh.gov, with one local news item, fetched October 29, 2026. Not covered: facility directory pages for Roby Park, Mine Falls Park, Southwest Park and Centennial Pool could not be fetched, so those entries rely on the park, pool and rink pages; program fees for Conway Arena and Nashua Senior Center are not included.
